summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The VolatilityShares Chainlink ETF (CHNL) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in long link, short usd currency. The fund is an actively managed fund, offering price participation in LINK, the native token of the Chanlink network, using near-term futures and LINK-related instruments. CHNL was launched on Apr 1, 2026 and is issued by Volatility Shares.
